pages.title: The Short List
pages.content:
We keep a short list of mechanical watches in our counter, with never more than twelve pieces at any time and five listed today. Each watch is hand-checked on our Ghent bench before it is offered for purchase or fitted at the counter.

WHAT WATCHES ARE CURRENTLY IN THE COUNTER

Our current counter display features five mechanical watches, each selected individually. The Aldren Square 28 from a Biel workshop pairs a 28 mm square steel case with a cream dial and a 42-hour hand-wound calibre at €1,420. From Aarhus, the Nordhaven Tide 39 features a 39 mm round steel case, slate dial, automatic movement, and 100 metres of water resistance at €1,640. Atelier Vell in Lyon produces the Vell Field 36, featuring a 36 mm steel case, matt black dial, and hand-wound movement at €1,280. Corvo Uhren in Pforzheim provides the Corvo Dress 34 in 34 mm steel with a silver dial on brown calfskin at €1,150. Finally, our pre-owned Calendar 35 from 1968 features a 35 mm steel case with date aperture, serviced by Tomasz Wrona, at €980.

HOW DOES ORDERING AND DELIVERY WORK FROM THE LIST

Every order placed from our short list is dispatched within two working days from Klokstraat 12 in Ghent. Insured European Union delivery is €18, and shipping is free for all orders over €1,000. Each piece is delivered with a fourteen-day return period, allowing you to examine the watch unworn with its protective film intact. If you prefer to handle the watch before purchasing, you can book a forty-five-minute visit at our counter, where your chosen piece is held for seven days.

pages.title: How We Choose
pages.content:
Since 2012, Kaname Watches has maintained a list of no more than twelve mechanical watches at Klokstraat 12 in Ghent. Founder Ilse Verhoeven evaluates every prospective piece against four consistent questions before it earns a place in our counter.

DOES IT KEEP GOOD TIME AFTER A WEEK ON TOMASZ'S BENCH

Ilse Verhoeven never adds a watch to our short list based on manufacturer claims alone. Before any piece joins the counter, watchmaker Tomasz Wrona opens the caseback and monitors its movement across multiple positions over seven full days. The calibre must maintain consistent amplitude, clean beat error, and steady daily rates before we approve it. If an escapement exhibits erratic variance or unstable regulation under observation on the bench, that watch does not join the collection at Klokstraat 12.

CAN IT BE SERVICED IN TEN YEARS

We deliberately select mechanical watches designed for enduring ownership and straightforward long-term maintenance. Tomasz inspects whether balance assemblies, mainsprings, reversing wheels, and case gaskets will remain accessible ten years down the road. Proprietary modules, glued components, or movements lacking accessible spare parts are rejected immediately. A watch that cannot be fully disassembled, cleaned, oiled, and regulated by an independent watchmaker has no place on the counter tray in our Ghent shop.

DOES IT SIT FLAT ON A 15 CM WRIST

Ergonomic balance matters far more than case diameter figures on paper. Ilse assesses how caseback depth, lug curvature, and strap attachment points settle on smaller wrists, adopting a 15 cm wrist circumference as our reference standard. Watches such as the Aldren Square 28 and Corvo Dress 34 lie comfortably flush without rocking or sliding off centre. If a watch feels top-heavy, snags against a shirt cuff, or resists resting naturally on the tray, we pass on it.

WOULD WE WEAR IT OURSELVES AND WHEN DOES A WATCH LEAVE THE LIST

Our final question is simple: would Ilse, Tomasz, Amara, or Jonas wear this watch every day? We cap the collection at twelve pieces so we can genuinely advocate for each one. When a maker modifies case proportions, switches to inferior movement suppliers, or discontinues replacement parts, Ilse removes that model from the list. Watches leave our counter quietly, ensuring our current selection of five pieces represents mechanical integrity we support without hesitation.

pages.title: The Bench
pages.content:
Our service bench in Ghent is run by watchmaker Tomasz Wrona, handling diagnostic checks, regular maintenance, and complete overhauls. We keep our service terms transparent with fixed prices, stated turnaround times, and twelve months of warranty on every full service.

WHAT ARE THE SERVICE PRICES AT THE BENCH

Tomasz Wrona manages our service bench at Klokstraat 12, offering eight clearly defined services at transparent prices. Counter visits and fittings of forty-five minutes are free by appointment. Bracelet or strap sizing is €15, provided free with any watch purchased from our list. Fitting a strap change is €20. Bespoke leather straps in calf or suede made to your wrist by Rafael Ortega in Porto cost €85. A same-day timing check and demagnetising is €45. A full overhaul for a hand-wound watch is €290, and a full automatic service is €340, each requiring four to six weeks and carrying a twelve-month warranty. Crystal replacement in mineral or sapphire starts from €60.

HOW DO YOU SEND A WATCH TO GHENT FOR BENCH SERVICE

Sending your watch to our Ghent workshop follows four straightforward steps. First, send an email to hello@kaname-watches.example outlining the watch model, case dimensions, and the service required. Second, receive our packing guidance and workshop reference number. Third, pack the watch securely in a padded parcel without original boxes and ship via tracked, insured courier to Klokstraat 12, 9000 Ghent. Fourth, Tomasz confirms arrival, carries out timing diagnostics, completes the work within four to six weeks, and returns the watch with twelve months of service warranty.

pages.title: Visit the Counter
pages.content:
Kaname Watches is located at Klokstraat 12 in Ghent, welcoming visitors by appointment for an unhurried fitting at our single glass counter. Amara Diallo sets out three mechanical watches on a wool felt tray so you can observe how each piece rests on your wrist.

HOW DO YOU ARRANGE A FORTY-FIVE MINUTE VISIT AT THE COUNTER

Arranging a visit follows four practical steps. First, book a forty-five-minute appointment online or by telephone at +32 9 555 01 12 up to two weeks in advance. Second, tell us your wrist circumference and what you currently wear. Third, Amara Diallo greets you at Klokstraat 12 and lays three watches out on our dark wool felt tray. Fourth, try each piece, verify the strap fit, and take seven days to make your decision, during which your chosen watch is held exclusively for you.

WHAT ARE OUR SHOP HOURS AND HOW DO YOU FIND KLOKSTRAAT 12

Our counter is open Tuesday through Friday from 11:00 to 18:00, with Thursday evening visits extended until 20:00. Saturday hours run from 10:00 to 17:00 with Jonas Albrecht, while Sunday and Monday are closed. We are located at Klokstraat 12, 9000 Ghent, Belgium. Visitors arriving by public transit will find tram stops located within three minutes of our front door, and municipal bicycle stands sit directly outside the building. Reach out by email at hello@kaname-watches.example to reserve your appointment.

pages.title: People
pages.content:
Six individuals care for Kaname Watches, dividing our focus between the Ghent counter, the watchmaker's bench, movement sourcing, and strap crafting. We work together in small numbers to maintain close attention on every watch that passes across our felt tray.

WHO SELECTS THE WATCHES AND RUNS THE BENCH

Founder Ilse Verhoeven established Kaname Watches in 2012, setting out our philosophy of keeping never more than twelve mechanical pieces on the list. Ilse personally evaluates and selects every watch that enters the shop. Working alongside her, watchmaker Tomasz Wrona runs the service bench at Klokstraat 12. Tomasz conducts arrival inspections, regulates escapements, performs same-day timing checks, and handles comprehensive overhauls taking four to six weeks, backing each completed service with a twelve-month warranty.

WHO MANAGES COUNTER FITTINGS AND CUSTOM LEATHER STRAPS

Amara Diallo manages the counter and hosts our forty-five-minute appointments at Klokstraat 12. She guides visitors through sizing, prepares the wool felt tray with three pieces, and helps evaluate wrist proportions in calm comfort. Partner leather craftsman Rafael Ortega works from his independent workshop in Porto, Portugal. Rafael handcrafts our bespoke calf and suede leather straps at €85, tailoring lug fit, length, and buckle positions to match each wearer's individual wrist measurement.

WHO HANDLES PRE-OWNED SOURCING AND SATURDAY DISPATCH

Mei-Lin Hsu leads our pre-owned sourcing, tracking down vintage mechanical pieces and verifying paperwork, case engravings, and movement serials before Tomasz opens the caseback. On Saturdays, Jonas Albrecht operates the Ghent counter, fits bracelets, provides sizing at €15, and coordinates our insured European Union deliveries. Jonas verifies protective films, carefully packs every order, and ensures prompt dispatch within two working days of order confirmation.

pages.title: Straps & Sizing
pages.content:
A mechanical watch must rest securely and comfortably against your wrist to be enjoyed every day. We partner with leather craftsman Rafael Ortega in Porto and provide in-house bracelet adjustments at our counter in Ghent.

HOW ARE RAFAEL ORTEGA'S LEATHER STRAPS MADE IN PORTO

Every leather strap in our shop is crafted by partner artisan Rafael Ortega in his Porto workshop. Available in vegetable-tanned calfskin or supple suede for €85, these straps are handmade to match your wrist measurement and case lug width. Rafael selects hides that age gracefully while maintaining thickness around the spring bars. Visitors at our Ghent counter can also arrange simple strap fitting for €20, or receive complimentary sizing when purchasing any watch from our short list.

HOW DO YOU MEASURE YOUR WRIST FOR AN ACCURATE STRAP FIT

Measuring your wrist accurately involves four simple steps. Step one: wrap a flexible tailor measuring tape around your wrist just behind the wrist bone. Step two: keep the tape flat without pulling tight or leaving gap slack. Step three: record your circumference in centimetres, usually ranging between 14 cm and 19 cm. Step four: consult our sizing table, where 14 to 15.5 cm requires Small, 16 to 17.5 cm fits Medium, and 18 to 19 cm corresponds to Large.

pages.title: Pre-Owned
pages.content:
Our pre-owned watches undergo rigorous verification before joining the short list in our Ghent counter. Mei-Lin Hsu verifies documentation and provenance, while watchmaker Tomasz Wrona performs a complete mechanical service on every vintage movement.

WHAT CHECKS DOES MEI-LIN HSU PERFORM ON PRE-OWNED WATCHES

Selecting vintage mechanical watches demands rigorous verification and patience. Mei-Lin Hsu inspects every prospective piece, confirming archival authenticity, dial condition, case serials, and historical paperwork. Once documentation is validated, Tomasz Wrona opens the caseback in our Ghent workshop to examine the train wheels, escapement, and balance assembly. Only sound, original movements enter our care, where they are fully disassembled, ultrasonically cleaned, fresh-lubricated, and regulated across positions before appearing in the counter.

WHAT WARRANTY AND CURRENT PIECES ARE AVAILABLE IN PRE-OWNED

Every pre-owned watch offered by Kaname Watches carries our twelve-month mechanical warranty, matching the coverage provided on our full bench overhaul. Our current featured vintage piece is the Calendar 35 from 1968, priced at €980. Housed in a 35 mm steel case with date function, this piece has been overhauled by Tomasz and fitted with a brown suede strap made by Rafael Ortega. You can examine it at Klokstraat 12 or order online with insured delivery.

pages.title: Delivery & Returns
pages.content:
We deliver mechanical watches across the European Union with full transit insurance, dispatched within two working days. You have fourteen days to inspect your watch unworn at home with complete peace of mind.

WHAT ARE THE DELIVERY TIMES AND INSURED SHIPPING RATES

We provide fully insured shipping throughout the European Union at a flat rate of €18, with complimentary delivery on all orders over €1,000. Jonas Albrecht manages packing and dispatch at Klokstraat 12 in Ghent, ensuring parcels are handed to our courier within two working days of purchase. Every shipment is tracked and fully insured against transit loss or damage, with courier tracking details sent directly to your email as soon as the package leaves our premises.

HOW DOES THE FOURTEEN-DAY RETURN PERIOD AND WARRANTY WORK

Every watch ordered online includes a fourteen-day return period starting from the date of delivery. To qualify for a refund, the watch must remain unworn with its transparent protective film intact on both case and crystal. All new watches on our short list come with a two-year warranty, while pre-owned watches and complete bench overhauls include twelve months of mechanical coverage. If warranty service is ever needed, Jonas coordinates insured return transport to Tomasz's Ghent bench.
